verdict.rationale: Gmail documents its own standard IMAP/POP access and a Gmail API whose listed use cases include read-only mail extraction, backup, and email account migration, with messages in RFC 2822 MIME format. Together these let a user pull mail out in an open format and move elsewhere. The evidence covers only mail and labels, not all account data, and shows no one-click bulk export. missing for 10: a documented first-party full-account export (e.g., an archive download), coverage of non-mail data such as contacts, filters and settings, and independent hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
